nodes.name: HTTP — TikTok Post Upload
nodes.notes:
TikTok Content Posting API v2
Required Cafe field: tiktokAccessToken (OAuth2 access token per cafe)
Note: TikTok API requires video content — for image posts use the Photo Post API instead:
  POST https://open.tiktokapis.com/v2/post/publish/content/init/
  with media_type: 'PHOTO'

nodes.name: HTTP — Snapchat Media Upload
nodes.notes:
Snapchat Ads API — organic story posting is not publicly available.
For organic: use Snap Kit's Creative Kit (iOS/Android SDK only, not REST).
Recommend: use Snapchat Ads API to sponsor the post instead.
Alternative: WATI / Twilio → send to customer's WhatsApp Status (Story).

nodes.name: HTTP — Smart Resto Blog Post
nodes.notes:
Publishes to Smart Resto's own blog/landing page.
The Express route /api/v1/blog/posts creates a public-facing review page
that is indexed by Google — targeting 'Best [cuisine] in [city]' keywords.

nodes.name: HTTP — Smart Resto Official Instagram+FB
nodes.notes:
Posts to Smart Resto's own Facebook Page AND Instagram Business account
(same Graph API token — FB Page + linked IG account).

Required env vars:
  SMARTRESTO_FB_PAGE_ID      — Smart Resto's own FB Page ID
  SMARTRESTO_FB_ACCESS_TOKEN — long-lived page access token for Smart Resto

nodes.notes:
Reunites all 4 paths:
  input1: Instagram Publish (North Africa)
  input2: Snapchat (GCC)
  input3: Other region Instagram fallback (reuses node-w3-006a-ig-step2)

main.node: Code — SEO Keywords + Official Captions (Free Tier)

notes:
GEO ROUTING LOGIC SUMMARY:

  Paid (6-Month / Annual):
    NORTH_AFRICA (Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Egypt)
      → Facebook Graph API (/{page-id}/photos)
      → Instagram Graph API (2-step: /media → /media_publish)

    GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman)
      → TikTok Content Posting API v2
      → Snapchat Ads API (or Snapchat Story via WhatsApp workaround)

    Other regions → Instagram Graph API only

  Free tier:
    → Smart Resto Blog (POST /api/v1/blog/posts)
    → Smart Resto Official Facebook Page + Instagram
    (SEO keywords auto-generated: 'Best cafe in [City] 2025')

REQUIRED CAFE MODEL FIELDS (add to Prisma schema):
  fbPageId           String  @default('')
  fbAccessToken      String  @default('')   // long-lived page token
  igUserId           String  @default('')   // Instagram Business account ID
  tiktokAccessToken  String  @default('')   // TikTok OAuth2 access token
  snapAccessToken    String  @default('')   // Snapchat OAuth2 access token

REQUIRED ENV VARS:
  API_BASE_URL                — Express backend URL
  INTERNAL_API_SECRET         — shared secret for n8n→Express auth
  SMARTRESTO_FB_PAGE_ID       — Smart Resto's own FB page (for free tier)
  SMARTRESTO_FB_ACCESS_TOKEN  — Smart Resto's own FB long-lived token

REQUIRED EXPRESS ROUTES:
  GET  /api/v1/review-gallery/:id/full          → joins ReviewGallery + Cafe
  PATCH /api/v1/review-gallery/:id/published    → sets published flags + n8nExecutionId
